tabs.title: Tab

tabs.content:
//See how many records are in the table.
TelemetryEvent
| where engine_temp_f > 200
| summarize count() by truck_id, bin(timestamp, 1h)
//| count


TelemetryEvent
| getschema

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
HOSStatusChangeEvent
| where driver_id == '7c60b9f5-b741-47d4-98d8-d1ddcee685d5'
| count

// View a representation of the schema as a table with column names, column type, and data type.
HOSStatusChangeEvent
| distinct driver_id
| limit 10


HOSStatusChangeEvent
| getschema 

HOSStatusChangeEvent
| summarize
    Rows=count(),
    Drivers=dcount(driver_id),
    MinTime=min(timestamp),
    MaxTime=max(timestamp)


    HOSStatusChangeEvent
| top 20 by timestamp desc
| project driver_id,
         timestamp,
         cycle_hours_remaining,
         cycle_hours_used

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
HOSStatusChangeEvent
| where driver_id == "9f68ed0d-7c4d-4aa2-b2c2-7a0e676def26"
| summarize min(timestamp), max(timestamp)
| take 100

HOSStatusChangeEvent
| getschema 

.set-or-append HOSStatusChangeEvent <|
HOSStatusChangeEvent
| where driver_id == "9f68ed0d-7c4d-4aa2-b2c2-7a0e676def26"
| extend timestamp = ago(10m), cycle_hours_used = 52.0, cycle_hours_remaining = 14.0, event_id = strcat(tostring(new_guid()));

.append HOSStatusChangeEvent <|
range i from 1 to 20 step 1
| extend
    event_id = strcat(tostring(new_guid())),
    event_type = "HOSStatusChangeEvent",
    timestamp = ago(20m) + i * 1m,
    source = "FabricTest",
    driver_id = "9f68ed0d-7c4d-4aa2-b2c2-7a0e676def26",
    trip_id = "f2ba0526-e359-43cc-9956-108ceb5462da",
    truck_id = "5acaa49b-a30e-4f91-bc8d-729c403d9bbc",
    previous_status = "driving",
    new_status = "driving",
    driving_hours_used = 40.0 + i * 0.1,
    driving_hours_remaining = 30.0 - i * 0.1,
    duty_hours_used = 50.0 + i * 0.1,
    duty_hours_remaining = 20.0 - i * 0.1,
    cycle_hours_used = 44.0 + i * 0.1,
    cycle_hours_remaining = 26.0 - i * 0.1,
    break_time_remaining_min = 30 - i,
    latitude = 40.7128 + i * 0.001,
    longitude = -74.0060 + i * 0.001


HOSStatusChangeEvent
| summarize count() by cycle_hours_used, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render columnchart
